line: Crowley's Eight of Wands is the card for the first decan of Sagittarius, with Mercury as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: The chapter names Mercury for the card; the sign Sagittarius comes from Crowley's attribution table (pdf 275), which has no quotation here.

quotes.quote: The Eight of Wands is called Swiftness
Mercury rules the card, thus bringing down from Chokmah

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: This card, therefore, represents energy of high velocity,
